traps.quote: A wheel that no public release record covers is legitimate and keeps working, as is a wheel served by a package index the operator configured. A wheel whose bytes match the published record also keeps working.
traps.note: Keep-working paragraph enumerates T1's three coupled cases one-to-one (matching bytes, no release record, operator-configured index); the 'already downloaded'/no-marker report shapes are not mentioned.

Only the route-agnostic 'installed only when it is the artefact its wheel name claims' reaches the replay route; nothing about recorded wheels, the local store or rebuilding a wheel from a stored filename.
